labSuite.title: Scientific Lab Tools & Calculators
labSuite.description: Precision biochemical and bioprocess calculators designed for algal culturing, kinetics, bioremediation, and carbon sequestration research.

growthCalculator.title: Microalgae Growth Rate Calculator
growthCalculator.subtitle: Specific Growth Rate & Doubling Time
growthCalculator.description: Calculate specific growth rate (μ) and doubling time (t_d) of microalgae cultures based on optical density (OD_600).

biomassCalculator.title: Biomass Productivity Calculator
biomassCalculator.subtitle: Volumetric & Areal Productivity Kinetics
biomassCalculator.description: Calculate volumetric biomass productivity (P_vol), areal yield, daily dry weight output, and annual harvest potential.

dilutionCalculator.title: Nutrient & Culture Media Dilution Calculator
dilutionCalculator.subtitle: C₁V₁ = C₂V₂ Solver & Algae Media Recipes
dilutionCalculator.description: Calculate required stock volumes, dilution factors, and batch scaling for standard algal culture media (BG-11, BBM, Zarrouk, f/2).

pollutantCalculator.title: Pollutant Removal & Biosorption Calculator
pollutantCalculator.subtitle: Wastewater Bioremediation & Adsorption Capacity
pollutantCalculator.description: Determine removal efficiency (R%), equilibrium adsorption capacity (q_e), and distribution coefficient (K_d) for heavy metals, dyes, and wastewater nutrients.

co2Calculator.title: CO₂ Sequestration Rate Calculator
co2Calculator.subtitle: Carbon Bio-fixation Kinetics & Environmental Offset
co2Calculator.description: Quantify microalgae carbon fixation rate, daily sequestered CO₂, and annual greenhouse gas mitigation based on biomass stoichiometry.

pigmentCalculator.title: Chlorophyll & Pigment Estimation Calculator
pigmentCalculator.subtitle: Spectrophotometric Assays & Cyanobacteria Phycobiliproteins
pigmentCalculator.description: Quantify Chlorophyll a, b, total carotenoids, and Spirulina phycocyanin (CPC, APC, PE) from spectrophotometer absorbance values.
